**Blue: LSTM + daily pattern · Green: seasonal pattern only · Orange: reactive · Purple: KEDA**

Same daily simulated schedule, four separate apps. Compare predictions with actual traffic in the **target-matched** charts; later forecast charts show predictions at observation time. Development observation; formal scoring has not started.

panels.title: How simulated traffic becomes a scaling decision

options.content:
1 · SIMULATE2 · OBSERVE3 · PREDICT4 · DECIDE5 · SERVE
k6 daily schedule
Quiet → rise → peak → fall		→Measured requests/minute
Prometheus traffic history		→LSTM + daily pattern
or seasonal pattern only
Six steps: +10 to +60 min		→Peak forecast in lead window
plus live-traffic safety floor
600 RPM per replica		→Desired pods → Ready pods
Limits, guards and scale-down
timers also apply

Blue · Hybrid: a trained LSTM neural network blended with the same clock-time pattern from previous days. At +10 min: 30% LSTM + 70% pattern. At +60 min: about 9% LSTM + 91% pattern. Training runs every 6 hours. Green · Seasonal: uses only the daily pattern in its final prediction; the shared service still computes network diagnostics.

Orange · Reactive: scales from traffic already observed. Prediction success: forecast dots would overlap actual traffic at the target time if accurate, and Ready capacity should arrive before demand rises. A running model alone does not prove either.

Timing: the 20-minute step is measured from the last input timestamp, so actual advance notice is shorter when that input is old. Unpredictable bursts still need the reactive safety floor.

panels.title: LSTM + pattern · predicted vs actual at target time
panels.description: Forecast samples are read 15 minutes earlier and included ONLY when their recorded target timestamp matches chart time within 30 seconds. This shows a subset of 20-minute-step forecasts, not every issuance. Dots are not joined or filled. The step starts at the input anchor, not issuance time. Scrape delays/held gauges can leave gaps. Diagnostic timing tolerance is not formal scored accuracy; use the verified forecast log for exact target scoring. Best viewed at 6 hours or less; wider ranges show fewer matched points. Pairing uses matching source labels before aggregation, including across controller restarts.
